Fix pushed: Gerrit change 3195 (commit c15bd6e0f64), awaiting votes. Description revised per the operator's decision (option 20): the replay test guards the new prompt's behaviour, and criterion 3 records the measured old-prompt drop rate instead of a deterministic failure. Re-ran review-plan: PASS, signed, 0 blocking, 4 advisory. 2 advisories (E5, G6) restate the accepted limit that the test does not reliably separate old from new prompt; G6's model concern is handled because the test pins the standard class explicitly. E6/F1/P6 note that the measurement criteria are attested in comments rather than by a command, which is intended.
Old-prompt drop rate on today's verifier settings (standard = bedrock sonnet-4-6, temperature 0): 1 of 10 runs across the real 1428 cases (PS2 replay 1/3, merged-commit replay 0/3, synthetic fixture 0/4 with 2 correct findings each). New prompt: PS2 replay kept the finding 3/3 (cra=yes); merged-commit replay test passed (finding kept, control vetoed, majority of 3).
Checks: make lint passes; make typecheck passes; pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_ws2.py tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py: 100 passed; the 34 unit/interface/script test files that reference tests/external: 599 passed. Live verifier calls in total: 18.
